description: This file defines the SerialDriver class within the WPEFramework::Bluetooth namespace, including nested classes and structures for managing serial communication with Bluetooth hardware, specifically for HCI over serial ports. It includes macro definitions, class methods for setup, reconfiguration, and data exchange, and internal data structures for request and response handling.

classes.name: SerialDriver
classes.description: Manages serial communication with Bluetooth HCI devices, including setup, reconfiguration, data exchange, and internal request/response handling.

classes.name: SerialDriver::Exchange
classes.description: Defines request and response structures for communication over the serial port, including command types and data serialization.

classes.name: SerialDriver::Exchange::Request
classes.description: Represents a request packet to be sent over the serial interface, with methods for serialization and resetting.

classes.name: SerialDriver::Exchange::Response
classes.description: Represents a response packet received from the serial interface, with methods for copying data from requests.

classes.name: SerialDriver::Exchange::Buffer
classes.description: A buffer class for handling incoming data streams and deserialization.

classes.name: SerialDriver::Channel
classes.description: Handles message exchange over the serial port, invoking parent class methods upon data reception.

methods.name: SerialDriver::Setup
methods.description: Configures the serial port with specified flags and protocol.

methods.name: SerialDriver::Exchange
methods.description: Performs data exchange over the serial port with specified request and response objects.

methods.name: SerialDriver::Reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the serial port with a new baud rate.

methods.name: SerialDriver::SetBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate of the serial port.

methods.name: SerialDriver::Received
methods.description: Virtual method called when data is received, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: SerialDriver::Convert
methods.description: Converts a baud rate value to the corresponding Core::SerialPort::BaudRate enum.
